name: Scope of extension permissions
evidence: The extension currently targets localhost and Gmail; deployed public URL is web-only.

name: Anonymous session gate and CSRF
evidence: Signed short-lived session, strict same-origin gate and CSRF token. Anonymous sessions are not account authentication.

name: Usage caps
evidence: Per-IP, per-session, concurrent and process-wide caps; reset on restarts, not a financial guarantee.

name: Cross-origin behavior
evidence: Production cross-site API requests denied. Local Chrome-extension loopback is development-only.

name: Deterministic crisis support
evidence: A narrow deterministic guard adds 988 resources in recognized self-harm cases; not comprehensive detection.

name: API key not embedded in extension
evidence: Provider API key is supplied server-side via an environment variable.
